In detail

Rated the second-safest district in the city by the 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey (4.04/5), described as having a "prestigious residential character" with a strong evening-safety score specifically (also 4.04/5). This district was not named in the City of Kraków's own 2022/2023 official safety survey's best- or worst-rated lists, so this rating rests on a single source — disclosed here rather than treated as fully corroborated. Sources checked: Otodom District Ranking 2020.
